_comment: DECORATIVE: the battery exercises ONE of toy-gate's two protections. Removing quote rejection changes no registered verdict, so the battery stays green and the protection is decoration. mutation-probe must report MUTATION-UNCAUGHT and exit non-zero on this tree (expect=BAD in the parent control). This is the whole of issue #970 reduced to six files: read against the covered tree, the two manifests differ by ONE case, and no amount of reading the GATE tells them apart.

mutations.name: comment-rejection
mutations.protection: a commented-out occurrence is not an occurrence

mutations.name: quote-rejection
mutations.protection: an occurrence inside a quoted string is advice, not the thing
